verdict.rationale: Elastic documents self-managed and on-prem deployment, as well as private or public cloud options, so a user can control where data lives by choosing where to run it. Nothing in the pack shows region selection or data-residency guarantees for Elastic-managed (Serverless) projects. Missing for 10: documented region selection for Elastic Cloud/Serverless projects, explicit data-residency or compliance guarantees, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Deploy anywhere: on-prem or in private or public cloud
Elastic provides several self-managed and Elastic-managed options.
Quickly set up Elasticsearch and Kibana in Docker for local development or testing
